label: First Way received-esse controls and POTENCY_1 boundary
paraphrase: Premise-free general result plus three finite semantic interpretations. Universal law: combining R1, R2 at ADOPTED unactualized POTENCY_1 in the esse respect and the existing-at-w → in-act-of-esse interface excludes all contingent beings at w. Positive nonvacuous witness: a contingent being receives esse in a principle and the principle is in receptive potency to its already possessed act; the unactualized subject transfer fails. Conservation model: contingent first mover is pure act under the adopted subject-level distribution but is externally supported and prior-caused in its esse exactly where it exists; firstness in being fails, and identity-scoped reception can be falsified by receipt in another principle. Brute candidate: a contingent first pure-act mover whose represented essence/esse differ but with no reception. These establish logical independence and a causal support interpretation, not metaphysical possibility.
